metadata.title: JX General Dynamics 0.6.0rc10
metadata.description:
JX General Dynamics 0.6.0rc10 is a reproducible release candidate of the JX celestial-dynamics engine. It adds the supported CPU GR15 V3 integrator for 2–32 fully mutual, positive-GM, unsoftened Newtonian point masses and fixes checkout-dependent wheel file modes. The archive contains exact source and wheel artifacts, release and artifact manifests, two-host GR15 acceptance reports, two-host CUDA core-gate reports, and a SHA-256 inventory.

Scientific status: SCREENING_ONLY. All numerical and timing results are finite, preregistered engineering screens. Timing was host-dependent, and no general speed advantage over REBOUND is claimed. This release is not a production ephemeris, lunar-model promotion, Planet X detection, scientific qualification, or general GPU qualification.
